plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate leveraged ETF exposure.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest returns.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for approximately 2.5% per month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It maintains some leveraged exposure while reducing overall concentration. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a focus on steady growth.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet mandate and free capital for higher growth.
Add SOXL to 6% and SPAL to 6% to increase leveraged ETF exposure.
Increase SMH to 19% and buy NVDU at 8% to concentrate in high-scoring setups.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this mode carries substantially higher drawdown risk, and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay, requiring strict stop discipline.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
